input.message_text: New opp from Alex: Botanica Beauty — UK brand, £1.2M ARR, ~4k DTC orders/mo, 800 SKUs, wants London or Manchester fulfillment, also sell on Amazon UK. Currently with a regional 3PL that can't scale. 200 pallets, ~5000 sq ft. Ships to EU. Go-live: March 2027. Haircare and skincare.

Brand: RidgeGear — outdoor apparel. ARR $3M. DTC orders ~2500/mo. SKU count TBD (still counting styles). Based in CO, wants Denver or Dallas fulfillment. 3 sales channels: Shopify, Amazon, REI wholesale. Go-live Q2 2027.
MegaPets — pet supplies. ARR $8M. 3,400 SKUs confirmed (huge catalog). Wants Los Angeles. DTC and Chewy wholesale. ~8000 orders/mo.
From Sam Patel: Luminos Home — premium candles. ARR £800k. 350 SKUs. Wants UK warehouse. 1200 DTC orders/mo. No international shipping needed. Go-live: June 2027.
